title: Locate an action or a state

variants.label: で · action

segments.role: で marks where studying takes place. The predicate names an action.

example.translation: I am studying at the library.

variants.change: で marks where studying takes place. The predicate names an action.

variants.label: に · presence

segments.role: に marks the location of existence with いる. The predicate also changes: the sentence now states presence.

variants.change: に marks the location of existence with いる. The predicate also changes: the sentence now states presence.

question: Which sentence says where the studying happens?
answers: 図書館で勉強しています。
feedback: Action-location で locates studying. Existence-location に locates a person with いる.
